verdict.rationale: Portkey's gateway can be run locally via a single npx/docker command (portkey-docs-2, portkey-docs-37) and its REST API is usable headlessly by changing base URL/headers (portkey-docs-15, portkey-docs-36), which supports CI-style automation. However, there's no explicit documentation of a CLI for CI pipelines, no mention of headless auth/service-account flows, and no examples of GitHub Actions/CI integration. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD examples or docs, non-interactive auth/service-token setup for automation, official CLI beyond npx gateway launch, and independent evidence of headless use in production pipelines.
